tasks.title: Bug 4: a loan can only be returned once

argv:
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from library import Library
from models import LoanError
L=Library()
for i in range(1,6): L.add_book('b%d'%i,'Title %s'%chr(64+i),2)
L.add_member('m1','Ann'); L.add_member('m2','Bob','premium')
L.checkout('m1','b1',1); L.return_book('m1','b1',5); L.checkout('m1','b1',10); print(L.return_book('m1','b1',12), L.books['b1'].available)
